extraction.name: RoboFAC dataset
extraction.description: A large-scale and diverse dataset of robotic failures covering robotic tasks of varying complexity in both simulated and real-world environments.
extraction.creator: Weifeng Lu, Minghao Ye, Zewei Ye, Ruihan Tao, Shuo Yang, Bo Zhao
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Simulation data was collected in the ManiSkill environment by replacing expert policies with code snippets that generate erroneous trajectories. Real-world data was collected via teleoperation using the SO-100 robotic arm.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: ManiSkill environment augmented with YCB Object Dataset, ReplicaCAD, and AI2-THOR for simulation, and SO-100 robotic arm for real-world data.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The original expert policy was replaced with a code snippet that generates an erroneous trajectory at a selected substage to cause the robotic task to fail.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Manual data cleaning was performed to remove trajectories that did not align with textual descriptions, retaining approximately 75% of the collected data.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Reference answers for five question types were extracted directly from textual descriptions. For the remaining three types, GPT-4o generated reference answers using video and text descriptions, which were then manually reviewed and corrected.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: To ensure annotation quality, all raw outputs generated by GPT-4o were manually reviewed and corrected to form the final reference answers.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The VLA model has a limited ability to follow complex natural language instructions, and the integration of the model into the VLA-controlled robotic system is not yet seamless.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluating multimodal models for robotic failure video understanding, task understanding, failure analysis, and failure correction.
